request_notes: Network order operations are limited to the documented network resource types; billing conversion and termination are confirmed non-retryable mutations.
On-demand conversion schedules or cancels conversion at expiry; it does not immediately convert the resource.
Delegation and logging APIs default to elb where documented. The vpc and dns choices remain explicit rather than silently changing the upstream default.
Endpoint bucket policies remain serialized JSON strings, not nested request objects.

notes: Tag, policy, log-project and metric results have no asynchronous terminal-state enums.
Delegation role query is a collection plus an aggregate check without a specific role identity input; no first-role waiter is inferred.
Billing operations return order IDs without an accompanying network order state query in this selected catalog; request success is not order completion.
